new_name.status: CURRENT AND FUTURE CANONICAL PROTOCOL NAME (effective 2026-08-26)

historical_preservation_rule.rule: Historical WLEP campaign artifacts, frozen snapshots, manifests, hashes, contract identities, conformance records, and model evidence remain identified as WLEP.
what_is_preserved: Frozen snapshot IDs starting with wlep-
Frozen protocol-freeze/manifest.json contents and hash tables
Frozen contract files starting with wlep- and their SHA-256
Frozen schema files starting with wlep_ and their SHA-256
Frozen campaign WLEP-CONFORMANCE.md, WLEP-END-TO-END-READINESS.md, WLEP validation files
Frozen Lab Record directory names (e.g. lab-records/<model>/wlep-2026-08-25/)
Frozen apodex, nemotron, lfm, qwen3.8 campaign evidence
Frozen OMP profile aliases (e.g. --profile wlep-apodex) that are campaign-local identifiers
Historical wlep-validation-2 campaign iteration path and contents
what_is_not_silently_rewritten: Historical wlep- contract filenames → welp- (FORBIDDEN, would invalidate frozen hashes)
Historical wlep_ schema filenames → welp_ (FORBIDDEN, would invalidate frozen hashes)

validators.rule: Current validators must accept BOTH legacy WLEP campaign identity AND current WELP campaign identity. They must NOT silently rewrite old IDs.
fixtures_required: historical WLEP manifest whose identity was improperly rewritten (REJECTED)

schemas.rule: Both wlep_*.schema.json (legacy) and welp_*.schema.json (current) machine-readable vocabularies are accepted by validators. Schema references inside frozen manifests remain unchanged.

contracts.rule: Frozen contract files starting with wlep- are immutable. New living-draft successor contracts are introduced as new files with the welp- prefix and a new version number.
contracts.successor_relationship: welp-<name> 0.1.x-draft is the new living successor draft of wlep-<name> 0.1.x-draft. The two files may be byte-identical aside from identifier metadata; if so the relationship is recorded explicitly in welp_contract_mapping.json.

conformance_filename.validator_rule: validators accept either filename; both pass required-file checks; campaign_validator_v2 logs which convention was used.

lab_record_directory.rule: Historical WLEP Lab Record directory names (e.g. .../wlep-2026-08-25/) are filesystem provenance. New campaigns may use a welp- prefixed directory name; legacy directories are NEVER renamed.

snapshot_ids.rule: Historical wlep-next-snapshot-* IDs are immutable. The first WELP snapshot uses welp-next-snapshot-2026-08-26-post-rename (DRAFT — NOT v1.0).

publication_routing.rule: Future records say: WELP snapshot / WELP conformance / WELP protocol findings / WELP Lab Record. Historical records that already say WLEP are not retroactively renamed in public records.

informal_tagline_optional: Run the evidence. Follow the gates. If the model fails: welp.
